desc.videoPlayer:
UnityVideoPlayer: Only general videos can be played. 
AVProVideoPlayer: In addition to general videos, you can also watch YouTube Live and twitch.
desc.playbackSpeed:
Video playback speed can be adjusted from 0.05x to 2.0x in 0.05x increments.
Video will reload when the video player is the AVPro Video Player.
desc.repeatPlay: Repeat playback of the specified section (A~B), automatically reset when the video changes.
desc.maxResolution: Sets the maximum resolution of the video, to be applied when the next video is played.
desc.brightness: Adjusts the brightness of the screen.
desc.karaokeMode:
The player who inserts the link will be the master. The video delay is automatically synchronized to the master voice. 
It is recommended to turn it on even if you need to adjust the delay manually.
desc.localOffset: Manually adjust the default playback delay. This option does not affect the master.
desc.slideMode:
Enables presentation mode.
Allows navigation between pages using 'Next' and 'Back' buttons.
desc.slideSeconds: Set the duration for each slide.
desc.ownerPermission: Full permission, this permission cannot be changed.
desc.adminPermission: In addition to the video player's operating permissions, the user's permissions can be edited.
desc.editorPermission: You can operate the video player, including playing and stopping videos.
desc.viewerPermission: Only viewing of videos is allowed.
msg.noPermissionDetail: You are not authorized and cannot operate.

msg.confirmChangePlayerDetail: Changing the video player will stop the video currently playing.
msg.confirmPlayUrlDetail: The video currently playing will stop.
